rhino.name: Iron Horn of the Valley
rhino.line: We march with the patience of stone and the force of the flood. Hold the fords; let the river run red.

tiger.name: General of Tiger
tiger.line: Stand firm, hold the fords, let no enemy breach our valley!

kite.name: Lord of the Wind
kite.line: Kite riders, seize the fords and let no messenger escape our talons!

rhino.thought: Watch 1. No intel. Standard opening: secure the river. F2 is central, F1 is western. Move inf-2 to F2, inf-1 to F1. Keep Cav/Arch/Ele at camp for defense and reaction. Use cipher to prevent interception.

tiger.thought: All squads are at TIGER CAMP (age 0). To begin securing fords we use smoke to make every unit advance to its nearest ford, positioning us at F3 and moving others toward F2/F1 for later holds.

kite.thought: Watch 1 of 30. All five Kite squads at KITE CAMP (0w old). No enemy sightings. Objective: hold two of three fords (F1, F2, F3) by watch 30. From KITE CAMP, fastest ford access: n-east → F3 (east), north-village → n-mid → F2 (middle). Will send infantry to seize F3 and F2; keep ar

orchid.thought: Start by securing our immediate area (Orchid Camp) and projecting influence towards the fords F1 and F2, as per doctrine. No enemy contact yet, so a cautious advance/hold is best.

rhino.thought: All squads at camp. Tiger smoke 'advance' suggests they are moving to a ford. No enemy sightings yet. My doctrine is hold. I will keep all units at camp to maintain readiness and avoid wasting movement on unverified threats, relying on camp defense until confirmed contact.

tiger.thought: No intel, only our starting positions. Doctrine is to hold. I'll move units to secure a central ford, F2, to establish presence.

rhino.thought: I have no enemy intel (0 reports). Tiger advanced W1, likely probing F3 or Kite. My doctrine is hold. I must secure the near fords (F1, F2) to win. I will move Inf-1 to F1 and Inf-2 to F2. Arch-1 stays at Camp to screen riders from Kite/Ochid. Cipher/road for speed.

orchid.thought: We must hold our ground and secure the fords. The tiger's advance (W1) is noted, but we have no immediate threats near our positions (W1). I will reinforce F1 and F2 to secure the river crossings, following doctrine.

tiger.thought: My doctrine is to hold. My forces are positioned near F3 (SE). I should reinforce F3 and perhaps use my cavalry to screen or harass nearby enemy positions, though I have no intel on them. I will hold my current positions.

rhino.thought: No fog reports (0w). Tiger advanced Watch 1, likely heading for F3. I hold camp. I will screen N-Mid and N-West to secure F2 and F1 against any enemy movement, keeping my main force at camp for rapid response.

kite.thought: All squads at KITE CAMP. Tiger advanced watch 1 (3 watches ago). No enemy contact. Need to secure fords F2 and F3 as they're closest. Sending inf to hold them, cav to screen east flank, arch and ele hold camp.

tiger.thought: It's Watch 4. My doctrine is hold. I need to secure key positions. Tiger units are near F3/S-east. I should reinforce F3 and keep pressure on enemy movement, though I have no direct intel on enemy positions.

orchid.thought: We need to project our forces towards the fords. Orchid inf-2 and arch-1 are near F1. Cav-1 and ele-1 are at camp. I will move inf-2 to F1 to reinforce our position and prepare for conflict, while using the archers to support. The doctrine is to hold.

rhino.thought: No enemy contact reported in 5 watches. Tiger smoke at Watch 1 is stale. Fords are the win condition. I must secure a ford before enemies do. Moving First Foot to F1 (West Ford) via N-West. F2 and F3 remain unclaimed. Holding others at camp to retain reserves.

orchid.thought: No new intelligence. My doctrine is to hold. I will reinforce key positions near my camp and fords, preparing for the next watch. The Tiger advance is noted but not immediately threatening my core.

tiger.thought: My doctrine is to hold. Tiger forces are at F3 (East Ford). Kite is at F3's neighbor (n-east). I need to secure F3 and potentially F2. I will hold F3 with my current forces and scout F2.

rhino.thought: No enemy contacts. Tiger advanced watch 1, likely probing or moving out. I must secure fords. F1 is closest to my camp via n-west. I will send inf-1 to hold F1 and inf-2 to hold n-mid (near F2) to establish a defensive line. Keep arch/cav/ele at camp for support.

orchid.thought: My doctrine is to hold. I have forces spread around my camp. I should reinforce key locations like F1 or F2 to secure a ford, or maintain a defensive posture. Since no enemy movements are reported, I will hold positions and prepare for action.

rhino.thought: I hold F1, but Orchid has Inf+Ele+Arch at F1/S-West (1w). My Inf is there; Ele/Arch at Camp. Kite threatens N-Village where my Cav/Inf are. I must secure F1 against the heavy force and protect the village. Holding is optimal to conserve strength for the long war.

tiger.thought: My doctrine is to hold. I see Kite at F3 (1w old). I should reinforce my positions and try to gain intelligence. Moving inf to F2 to secure a ford and apply pressure.

orchid.thought: Rhinos are at F1. My inf/arch/ele are at F1/SWB. I must secure F1. My doctrine is to hold. I will reinforce F1.
